reason: I'm not letting an AI answer my customers or post for me when I can't see what it will say first. And on 32k a year, 59 to 99 euros a month is real money for something I'm not sure I'd trust.
objection: AI talking to my customers could damage my reputation. One wrong answer or a made-up promise and I lose a client, and 'GDPR-compliant' on a website isn't proof of anything.
would_change_my_mind: Being able to approve every message before it goes out to a customer, plus seeing real Belgian or French small businesses like mine using it without problems. I might try the free plan in draft-only mode.
